intro.en: In the heart of Centro, inside the silent halls of the Municipal Library, a priceless 16th-century map has been sliced from its atlas. The thief left behind a smell of expensive perfume and a single torn thread of silk.
intro.pt: No coração do Centro, nos corredores silenciosos da Biblioteca Municipal, um mapa do século XVI foi cortado de seu atlas. O ladrão deixou para trás um cheiro de perfume caro e um único fio de seda rasgado.

suspects.name: Arthur Sterling

persona.en: Stiff, elderly, and obsessed with order.
persona.pt: Rígido, idoso e obcecado por ordem.

alibi.en: He was organizing the archives in the basement.
alibi.pt: Ele estava organizando os arquivos no porão.

suspects.facts: You were in the basement at 21:00. You lie that the basement door was locked all night to hide that you lost the keys earlier.

suspects.name: Elena Vance

persona.pt: Ansiosa, viciada em cafeína e altamente inteligente.

alibi.en: She was studying in the reading room.
alibi.pt: Ela estava estudando na sala de leitura.

suspects.facts: You were in the reading room at 21:00. You lie that you didn't see anyone near the atlas to avoid being a witness.

suspects.name: Julian Thorne

alibi.en: He claims he was leaving the library through the main exit.
alibi.pt: Ele afirma que estava saindo da biblioteca pela saída principal.

suspects.facts: You were in the Rare Books Room at 21:15. You lie that you were merely admiring the binding of a different book while you cut the map.

suspects.name: Clara Oswald
suspects.facts: You were in the corridors at 21:00. You lie that you didn't hear anything to avoid being interrogated by the police.

event.en: The library closes for the evening.
event.pt: A biblioteca fecha para a noite.
Arthur é ouvido trabalhando no andar de baixo.

event.en: The map is stolen using a precision blade.
event.pt: O mapa é roubado usando uma lâmina de precisão.

clues.ask: Where were you during the theft?

text.en: I was in the basement; I saw Elena in the reading room through the glass partition, she never left her desk.
text.pt: Eu estava no porão; eu vi a Elena na sala de leitura através da divisória de vidro, ela nunca saiu da mesa.

text.en: I didn't see much, but I distinctly remember a very strong, expensive floral perfume passing by my table.
text.pt: Não vi muito, mas me lembro nitidamente de um perfume floral muito forte e caro passando pela minha mesa.

clues.ask: What did you find while cleaning?

text.en: I found a blue silk thread caught on the edge of the atlas display case.
text.pt: Eu encontrei um fio de seda azul preso na borda da vitrine do atlas.

text.en: I saw nothing but old books and dust.
text.pt: Não vi nada além de livros velhos e poeira.

text.en: Focus on the sensory evidence: the perfume and the silk thread.
text.pt: Foque nas evidências sensoriais: o perfume e o fio de seda.

text.en: Who among the suspects wears expensive clothing and high-end fragrances?
text.pt: Quem entre os suspeitos usa roupas caras e fragrâncias de luxo?

solution.en: Julian Thorne is the culprit. Elena's testimony about the expensive perfume and Clara's discovery of the blue silk thread (matching Julian's luxury attire) point directly to him. Furthermore, Elena's alibi was confirmed by Arthur, clearing her.
solution.pt: Julian Thorne é o culpado. O testemunho de Elena sobre o perfume caro e a descoberta de Clara do fio de seda azul (combinando com as roupas de luxo de Julian) apontam diretamente para ele. Além disso, o álibi de Elena foi confirmado por Arthur, inocentando-a.

en.headline: Librarian Wrongly Accused
en.body: Arthur Sterling was detained today, but evidence shows he was merely a victim of poor security.

pt.headline: Bibliotecário Injustamente Acusado
pt.body: Arthur Sterling foi detido hoje, mas as evidências mostram que ele foi apenas vítima de uma segurança deficiente.

en.headline: Researcher Under Fire
en.body: Elena Vance faces investigation after being mistaken for the map thief.

pt.headline: Pesquisadora Sob Suspeita
pt.body: Elena Vance enfrenta investigação após ser confundida com a ladra do mapa.

en.headline: Janitor Misidentified
en.body: The library staff is in shock after a wrongful accusation against Clara Oswald.

pt.headline: Faxineira Identificada Erroneamente
pt.body: A equipe da biblioteca está em choque após uma acusação errônea contra Clara Oswald.

generated.seed: A library in the Centro: a rare map is cut from an atlas
